ui.subtitle: Rules aligned to SOC 2 Trust Service Criteria for audit-ready compliance.

rules.message: Hardcoded credential — use environment variables or a secrets manager.
rules.recommendation: Read secrets from environment variables or a secrets manager. Never embed them in source code.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks the matching action only on surfaces marked hard or conditional when their listed dependencies are satisfied.
requires: A supported pre-tool hook is installed, synced, and invoked before the action
The agent invokes MCP guard_check with accurate tool_name and tool_input before acting
known_limitations: Hook enforcement depends on the AI tool emitting supported structured hook events
MCP cannot enforce actions the agent does not submit to guard_check
Workflow runtime skips rules restricted to non-workflow tool families

rules.description: Warn on PII logged to console (SOC2 CC7.2)
rules.message: Possible PII in logs — scrub before production.
rules.recommendation: Redact or hash PII before logging. Use structured logging with field-level redaction.

rules.description: Warn on DEBUG=True in production config
rules.recommendation: Set DEBUG=False in production. Use feature flags or env-gated config for verbose logging.

rules.description: Warn on unencrypted write with sensitive filename
rules.message: Writing sensitive data unencrypted — use a secrets manager.
rules.recommendation: Enable storage encryption (AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit). Use managed KMS for key rotation.
